normativeReference.meaning: requiredFusedPlasma is the total fused-only target, not a shortfall or fusion amount to combine with the recommended PoW.

behavior.calculation: Reuses the unchanged calculateDynamicPlasmaPriceAmounts kernel with fixed scale 1000 and difficulty-per-plasma 1500, checked BigInt inputs and a private safe-result guard.
validates: Exact ordinary enumerable own DATA schemas
behavior.alternativeSeparation: fusedOnlyTarget pairs the total with difficulty 0; declaredRecommendation retains the separately calculated fusion/PoW recommendation.
behavior.zeroMeaning: Encoded zero is retained as declared RPC structure data; it does not prove an admissible zero-cost block.
notEstablished: Any action, signing or payment authority
behavior.unsupported: Legacy/frontier versions other than 2 and non-safe JS numeric values fail closed. This is not a lossless uint64 JSON token parser.
